# sprint issues attachments save

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../../README.md) · [Parent](../attachments.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues attachments save — HTTP(S) URL metadata only; credentials rejected and URL is never fetched. Issue access and write permission are checked on every request.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues attachments save --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  HTTP(S) URL metadata only; credentials rejected and URL is never fetched. Issue access and write permission are checked on every request.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues attachments save --file input.json --operation-key KEY

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (required for existing resource)
  --operation-key KEY (required for create)
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  The example input.json creates a new record without id; --operation-key is required. To update, include id and the current --expected-revision.
  API action: collaboration.saveAttachment
  JSON input for --json-data/--file: {"type":"object","properties":{"issue":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"title":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"url":{"type":"string","pattern":"^https?://","maxLength":5000}},"required":["issue","title","url"],"additionalProperties":false}

SEE ALSO
  sprint help issues attachments
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/issues/attachments/save.md
```
